## D — Accuracy and evidence notes: Following, merging, crossing and passing space
Every knowledge statement for Following, merging, crossing and passing space is tied to one physical page of the registered Delaware handbook snapshot. No outside legal explanation or inferred exception is added.
The baseline following procedure does not erase conditions requiring more space. The motorcycle, truck and weather guidance is preserved with its own scope rather than replacing earlier conditions with one universal gap.
The internally inconsistent merge-gap arithmetic is not minted. Passing figures remain conditional examples; a mirror cue never replaces sufficient clearance or a safe, permitted maneuver.
Open source limitation (verify DE-SPACE-MERGE-MATH): The merge passage says splitting a four-second gap produces three-second following gaps on both sides. That arithmetic is inconsistent; the fixed merge-gap explanation is withheld pending issuer correction and must not be used to certify a safe gap.
Open source limitation (verify DE-SPACE-CYCLIST-SCOPE): The side-space continuation says not to share a lane with a cyclist, while the earlier detailed bicycle rule permits in-lane passing in unusually wide lanes under stated conditions. The unqualified prohibition is withheld until its scope is reconciled.
Open source limitation (verify DE-SPACE-PASSING-EXAMPLE): The fixed passing-time and distance illustration does not fully specify the passed vehicle or all maneuver conditions. Preserve it as an approximate source example; never turn it into a universal permission or guarantee.
Source quality: official issuer PDF. Extraction is text only; graphical content does not become a fact unless its supporting meaning is stated in the text. Unknown exam metadata and market evidence remain typed debt.
